title.en: Upgrades LUNA Base to v0.9.3. A program runs for a short time and then LUNA Base comes back. After that, please download your firmware again

changes.en: Fixed in LUNA Base v0.9.3: with a dev server set, LUNA Store sometimes showed only a few tabs (it now reads the dev catalog after the public catalog). While the dev server card is closed, the dev catalog is not read. No USB needed. It takes about 20 seconds (do not switch off). Your Wi-Fi settings and firmware settings are kept. If the page does not change after the last beeps, reload the page

body.en: Only the LUNA Base upgrade is shown here. Install LUNA Base from "Firmware" to upgrade it; then all firmware, star charts and apps appear in LUNA Store. If you still see this screen after the upgrade, press "↻ Refresh".
